What's this "class trial" that Monokuma mentioned? Can Makoto sweep away the cloud of suspicion surrounding him, even with a dead body laying in his bathroom? And what about the blackened who's actually responsible for Sayaka's death?
The bizarre class trial begins again. Why was Chihiro murdered? Is the killer hiding within the group? Is there any help to be found in this series of murders...?
And now they must confront *two* murders...! Who claimed the lives of Hifumi and Kiyotaka? In this class trial, suspicion builds upon suspicion!
Multiple suspects. Murder in a locked room. If anyone was likely to survive, it was Sakura. And yet...
Memories float back, Kyoko is gone, and a mysterious masked body appears—the threads holding them all together begin to spin and twine into one...
The mastermind stands exposed, and must pay for their crimes. Now all that's left is the looming mystery of Hope's Peak Academy itself...

• Influence Gauge
If you choose the wrong statement or Truth Bullet, you will
take damage. If your Influence Gauge reaches 0, that will
end the case.

• Focus Gauge
This determines how much concentration you can do.

• Concentration
By holding down the %CTRL_TRIAL_CONCENTRATE%, you can concentrate and slow
down the passage of time. This will consume your Focus
Gauge, and you can't concentrate when it's empty.

• Fast-Forward
Hold down the %CTRL_TRIAL_SPEED_UP% to speed up the debate.

When a character is talking, some text may appear in yellow.
This is their weak spot, and it represents a potential lie
or contradiction in their argument. Multiple weak spots may
appear, and it's up to you to figure out the right one and
attack it, which will allow you to move the trial forward.

• Firing Truth Bullets
Press the %CTRL_TRIAL_SHOOT% to fire whatever Truth Bullet 
you have loaded.

• Loading Truth Bullets
%CTRL_TRUTH_BULLET_DETAIL%

• Quick Select
If you quickly press the %CTRL_QUICK_SELECT%, Truth Bullets will be
automatically loaded according to their order.

• Truth Bullet Flashback
If you target a weak spot and then hold down the
%CTRL_TRIAL_SHOOT%, you can use that weak spot 
as a temporary Truth Bullet later in the argument. 
These "Flashback" bullets will disappear as soon 
as you use them or switch to another Truth Bullet.

You can eliminate "white noise" with your silencer by
targeting it and press the %CTRL_TRIAL_SHOOT_SILENT%. If you successfully

original: • Influence Gauge During a Bullet Time Battle, you will take damage to your Influence Gauge whenever your opponent's statements explode. If this gauge reaches 0, you will fail the case.  • Tempo Marker This indicates the current tempo, and you'll have to press buttons in rhythm. Failing to hit a statement in time will count as a Miss.  • Combos and "Tempo Up" If you're able to keep up with the rhythm, you can eventually perform a combo. Get your combo past a certain level and the rhythm will change, resulting in a "Tempo Up." On the flipside, if you keep on missing, that will result in a "Tempo Down."  • Lock On (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_LOCK_ON%) As you continue to match the rhythm, you will have the chance to lock on to an enemy statement. At this point, press the %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_LOCK_ON% to lock on.  • Attack (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_ATTACK%) Once you're locked on to a statement, press the %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_ATTACK% to destroy it and deal damage  to the enemy. You can also lock on to multiple statements  and destroy them all at once. If you can pull that off,  you'll do more damage than if you'd destroyed them  one at a time. As you attack, you'll consume ammo.  If you run out of bullets, you'll be forced to reload.  • Reload (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_RELOAD%) Press the %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_RELOAD% in time with the rhythm to reload your bullets; each button press will reload one bullet. If your difficulty level is set to Kind, you will not have to reload.  • Fever Time (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_FEVER%) Press the %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_FEVER% to activate Fever Time, which will consume the Focus Gauge. During Fever Time you will not be required to reload, and the tempo will be forced to its maximum.  • Nega Time During the battle, your enemy may activate Nega Time. When this happens, the Tempo Marker will disappear, making it more difficult to match the timing. In addition, their word bombs will explode after a shorter amount of time. If your difficulty level is set to Kind, Nega Time will never occur.  • Final Strike Once you've destroyed the enemy's Influence Gauge, they'll deliver their closing remark. Target this statement with a Truth Bullet, then destroy it by pressing the  %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_ATTACK%. If you use the right Truth Bullet,  the statement will be destroyed, but if you get it wrong,  you'll take damage and the enemy will recover some of their Influence Gauge.  Use the %CTRL_TRIAL_KEY_INFORMATION% to choose  the Truth Bullet you'd like to use.
raw:
• Influence Gauge
During a Bullet Time Battle, you will take damage to
your Influence Gauge whenever your opponent's statements
explode. If this gauge reaches 0, you will fail the case.

• Tempo Marker
This indicates the current tempo, and you'll have to press
buttons in rhythm. Failing to hit a statement in time will
count as a Miss.

• Combos and "Tempo Up"
If you're able to keep up with the rhythm, you can
eventually perform a combo. Get your combo past a certain
level and the rhythm will change, resulting in a "Tempo Up."
On the flipside, if you keep on missing, that will result in
a "Tempo Down."

• Lock On (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_LOCK_ON%)
As you continue to match the rhythm, you will have the
chance to lock on to an enemy statement. At this point,
press the %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_LOCK_ON% to lock on.

• Attack (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_ATTACK%)
Once you're locked on to a statement, press the
%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_ATTACK% to destroy it and deal damage 
to the enemy. You can also lock on to multiple statements 
and destroy them all at once. If you can pull that off, 
you'll do more damage than if you'd destroyed them 
one at a time. As you attack, you'll consume ammo. 
If you run out of bullets, you'll be forced to reload.

• Reload (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_RELOAD%)
Press the %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_RELOAD% in time with the rhythm to reload your
bullets; each button press will reload one bullet. If your
difficulty level is set to Kind, you will not have to
reload.

• Fever Time (%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_FEVER%)
Press the %CTRL_BULLET_TIME_FEVER% to activate Fever Time, which will
consume the Focus Gauge. During Fever Time you will not
be required to reload, and the tempo will be forced to
its maximum.

• Nega Time
During the battle, your enemy may activate Nega Time. When
this happens, the Tempo Marker will disappear, making it
more difficult to match the timing. In addition, their word
bombs will explode after a shorter amount of time. If your
difficulty level is set to Kind, Nega Time will never occur.

• Final Strike
Once you've destroyed the enemy's Influence Gauge, they'll
deliver their closing remark. Target this statement with a
Truth Bullet, then destroy it by pressing the 
%CTRL_BULLET_TIME_ATTACK%. If you use the right Truth Bullet, 
the statement will be destroyed, but if you get it wrong, 
you'll take damage and the enemy will recover some of their Influence Gauge. 
Use the %CTRL_TRIAL_KEY_INFORMATION% to choose 
the Truth Bullet you'd like to use.
